Name: Less Mini Shipping Bin
Author: atravita
Description:
Lets you set the capacity of the mini shipping bin higher. (Up to [s]48[/s] 120 whole slots!) Also lets you set the capacity of the jumino chests higher, as well as small chests, big chests, and fridges. All separately.

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. In multiplayer, probably best if everyone installs the mod.
[/list]
[size=5]See also[/size]

[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/atravita-mods/StardewMods/blob/main/LessMiniShippingBin/LessMiniShippingBin/docs/changelog.md]Release notes[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://github.com/atravita-mods/StardewMods/blob/main/LessMiniShippingBin/LessMiniShippingBin]Source code[/url]﻿
[/list]

Requires SMAPI, uses Harmony.
